articles.title: ESA and the EU partner with Museo Galileo on new exhibition
articles.summary: The European Space Agency (ESA), Italy’s Museo Galileo - Institute and Museum of the History of Science, and the European Commission (EC) have partnered to uncover the surprising and far-reaching connections between the pioneer astronomer Galileo Galilei and Europe’s satellite navigation system Galileo.

articles.title: Callisto Reusable Rocket Demonstrator Takes Shape Ahead of 2027 Hop Test
articles.summary:
The German Aerospace Center (DLR) has completed final testing of the nose cone for the Callisto reusable rocket demonstrator, with the hardware now set to be transferred to France for final integration.
